basic_info.description: Fixer-Upper with huge potential! Classic 1941 single-family home just 1.5 blocks from Golden Gate Park in the highly desirable Richmond District. 1,240 +/- square feet of living space on a generous 2,850 +/- square foot lot. Covered breezeway vestibule entrance on lower-level leads to main level featuring kitchen, formal living & dining rooms, 2 spacious bedrooms each with large walk-in closets, and 1 full bathroom with stall shower, separate tub, vintage tile, and pedestal sink. Original hardwood floors under the carpet throughout, 3 skylights, wood-burning fireplace with brick firebox, and ornate mantel. South facing windows add abundant natural light to common rooms. Internal stairway connects main level to lower level with laundry area and large 1-car garage, plus BONUS bedroom & bathroom. Unusually deep backyard with mature apple tree - waiting for landscaping! Newer roof (4 years old). Pet-free property with solid structure & original architectural details including vintage molding & arched doorways. Steps to Golden Gate Park, De Young Museum, California Academy of Sciences, and diverse Clement Street dining. Tenant-occupied - endless possibilities for the right buyer who is ready to renovate this Central Richmond District diamond in the rough!
